routes.name: mccarren park track

waypoints.query: McCarren Park Track, Brooklyn, NY

routes.notes: 400 m around the turf field, entrance near driggs ave & lorimer st. open dawn to dusk, free. share lanes and yield to scheduled school and community programs. lane 1 is 400 m; each lane further out adds about 7-8 m a lap. the jog over (about 0.6 mi on driggs ave) is a good start to your warm-up.

routes.notes: a long steady climb over newtown creek on the bridge's walking and bike path. for hill work in later phases. the approaches are industrial with truck traffic; daylight only, and check the path on the map before you go.

routes.notes: south through williamsburg to the bridge's pedestrian path: a real hill each way. turn at the top or cross to manhattan for more miles.
